correctness.rationale: Unitary gauge on a finite nilpotent shift gives w(S)=λ_max(S+S*)/2. Continuant expansion in the exceptional squared weight r² gives P_{n,k}=Q_n−(r²−1)Q_{k−1}Q_{n−k−1}; Chebyshev determinant/product identity yields P_{n,k+1}−P_{n,k}=−(r²−1)Q_{n−2k−2}. Perron positivity shows λ_max(J_{n,k})>2cos(π/(n+1)), greater than the largest zero of Q_{n−2k−2}, so P_{n,k+1}(λ_{n,k})<0; monicity ensures a strictly greater new top root for every admissible integer n,k and every r>1. Reflection k↔n−k accounts for only mirror ties. Independently checked continuants and Chebyshev products for n=4,…,7; universal strictness comes from the analytic sign argument.
